description: A four-stage envelope generator with sliders and a CV input for each stage

params.text: How long the envelope takes to climb to 10V, from instant to about 10 seconds
How long the envelope takes to fall from 10V to the sustain level
The level the envelope holds while the gate stays high
How long the envelope takes to fall back to 0V after the gate drops

inputs.text: Added to the ATT slider, 10V covering the slider's whole travel
Added to the DEC slider, 10V covering the slider's whole travel
Added to the SUS slider, 10V covering the slider's whole travel
Added to the REL slider, 10V covering the slider's whole travel
The envelope rises while this is at 1V or more, and releases once it drops below 1V
A trigger here sends the envelope back to its attack stage during a held gate

inputs.4: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.5: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
